releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.6.0 - PPPoE Subscriber Management & Settings Redesign
releaseNotes:
• PPPoE Subscriber Tab: Dynamically shown only when your router has a PPPoE server configured — hidden automatically for hotspot-only setups
• PPPoE Management: Create, renew, disable/enable, and delete PPPoE subscribers directly from the app
• Smart Expiry Tracking: Per-subscriber expiry countdown with color-coded warnings (red <3d, yellow <7d, green OK)
• Speed Limits per User: Set download/upload Mbps and optional data cap per subscriber
• Active Sessions View: Real-time PPPoE active session list with IP address and uptime
• Enable PPPoE from Settings: New Settings tab option to configure PPPoE server on any router that doesn't have it yet
• Settings Screen Redesign: Dedicated Settings tab replacing the old modal — Account, Connection, Routers list, PPPoE control, App preferences
• Web App PPPoE Tab: hotspot-admin.pages.dev now includes a PPPoE subscriber management tab with search, filter, renew, disable, and delete
• Stability Tab Removed from Web App: Router stability monitoring merged into Dashboard for cleaner navigation
• Network-Aware Subnet Selection: IP pool automatically scales with max users (≤245→/24, ≤500→/23, ≤1000→/22)
